description: Lint an x402 endpoint's unpaid 402 and report, per directory, whether it meets what x402dash (unpaid GET must return 402), x402scan (OpenAPI x-payment-info or /.well-known/x402, input schema), the402 (validator 'payable') and the CDP/PayAI Bazaar (bazaar extension, description <= 500 chars, non-tunnel https host; listing then needs one settled payment) were known to check. Never pays. Free.
name: check_directory_readiness
